description: This file contains test functions for the litellm library, specifically testing logging integrations with logfire during language model completions and asynchronous completions. It sets up test scenarios using pytest, including skipping tests on CI/CD pipelines, and leverages fixtures and parametrization to test both streaming and non-streaming cases.

methods.name: test_completion_logfire_logging(stream)
methods.description: Synchronous test function that runs a completion request with logfire logging enabled, testing both streaming and non-streaming modes.

methods.name: test_acompletion_logfire_logging(stream)
methods.description: Asynchronous test function that runs an async completion request with logfire logging enabled, testing both streaming and non-streaming modes.
